{{NSE|POLYPLEX}} | founded = {{Start date|1984}} | founder = [[Sanjiv Saraf]]{{cite news |title=Sanjiv Saraf: A Saviour Of Languages |url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/leadership/sanjiv-saraf-a-saviour-of-languages/83579/1 |access-date=8 July 2023 |work=Forbes India |language=en}} | hq_location_city = [[Noida]], [[Uttar Pradesh]] | hq_location_country = India | hq_location = | num_locations = | area_served = Worldwide | key_people = | industry = Packaging | products = Plastic and Polyester Film | brands = {{hlist|Sarafil| Saracote| Saralam| Saraprint}} | revenue = {{up}} {{INRconvert|6752|c}} (FY22) | operating_income = | net_income = {{up}} {{INRconvert|568|c}} (FY22){{cite news |title=Polyplex Corporation Ltd Q4FY22 consolidated PAT up at Rs. 185.78 crores |url=https://www.equitybulls.com/category.php?id=314038 |access-date=8 July 2023 |work=EquityBulls |date=26 May 2022}} | num_employees = | website = {{URL|www.polyplex.com}} | footnotes = | intl = }} '''Polyplex Corporation Ltd.''' is an Indian multinational company which produces [[PET film (biaxially oriented)|biaxially oriented polyester]] (BoPET) film for packaging, electrical and various industrial applications.{{cite web |url = http://www.polyplex.com/index.htm |title = POLYPLEX Corporation Limited (World's 4th Largest Manufacturers of Thin Polyester Films) |publisher = [[W3C]] |date = 2012-01-01 |accessdate = 2012-01-01 |archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20111221021813/http://www.polyplex.com/index.htm |archive-date = 21 December 2011 |url-status = dead }} {{sps|date=December 2020}} The company is a major exporter of PET film to the [[United States]], [[Europe]], [[Southeast Asia]], [[South America]] and [[Australia]]. ==Manufacturing facilities== It has manufacturing facilities in India, Thailand, Turkey, the US, and Indonesia. extract:
Polyplex Corporation Ltd. is an Indian multinational company which produces biaxially oriented polyester (BoPET) film for packaging, electrical and various industrial applications.
The company is a major exporter of PET film to the United States, Europe, Southeast Asia, South America and Australia.
